column3: Held up towards the back early - up to 4th by halfway - driven for effort with 2f left - moved into 2nd a furlong out - hit the front 150 yards out and stayed on strongly to win
Sat behind front pair early - third at halfway - urged forward approaching final 2f - forced into second inside final 150 yards - stayed on same rate but couldn't close on winner
Settled midfield early - faded towards the back by halfway - driven approaching final 2f and responded well inside it - took 3rd on the line

Set the pace early - overtaken before the first furlong - fought back into it approaching halfway - driven back in front with two furlongs to run - urged on and hard-chased a furlong out then weakened into third around 150 yards out - slipped back again near the line to finish 4th
Held up at back - urged forward with two furlongs left - stayed on under pressure late to grab 5th near the line
Held up towards the back - moved into 5th by halfway - urged into contention approaching 2f out - lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish 6th
Tracked pace early - hit front approaching 2f - shared advantage at halfway - shaken up and lost command over 2f out - stayed on same pace before fading inside final furlong to finish 7th
Settled behind pace early - still second at halfway - driven up to dispute inside final 2f - edged clear right on the line
Went straight to the front - shaken up and challenged hard over 2f out then held the advantage to a furlong out - unable to find more and edged out right at the finish
Sat behind the front group early - third at halfway - urged into contention over 2f out but couldn't quicken from 1f out - stayed on same gear to finish third
Held up towards the back - urged forward with over 2f left - pressed for effort inside the final furlong - stayed on to take 4th near the line
Settled midfield - 5th at halfway - urged forward approaching 2f out to move into 4th - stayed on through the final furlong but found nothing more - eased back a spot near the line finishing 5th
Towards the back of the pack - urged forward with two furlongs left and responded well - moved into 6th late on
Held up at back - asked for effort over 2f out - late progress inside final furlong to take 7th near the line
Settled towards the back of the pack - moved into 6th with two furlongs left then pushed into 5th approaching the final furlong - faded in the closing stages to finish 8th
Sat handy behind pace-setters - 6th at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out but found little - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 9th
Sat behind the front group - 4th at halfway - driven early in the straight with no response over 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 10th
Bumped start - settled behind pace - pushed to front inside final 2f - drifted left approaching finish and stayed on strongly to win
Handy early - hit front after 2f - driven from 2f out and lost lead inside final furlong - drifted left but stayed on gamely to finish second by a half length
Slow to stride - settled at the back - angled wide 2f out - made up ground on the outside inside the final furlong - kept on strongly to finish third
Close to pace early - drifted into the pack soon after - pressed for effort inside final furlong and drifted left but stayed on to finish 4th
Raced with enthusiasm early - settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - made progress a furlong out - flattened out close home to finish 5th
Sluggish start and urged forward - settled at back of field before angling left with a furlong left - stayed on at same effort to finish sixth beaten 3½ lengths
Raced up early - fought the bridle in the pack - lost touch with the front 3f out - drifted towards the rail in the closing stages - stayed on without progress to finish 7th beaten 3¾ lengths
Hampered and drifted left at the break - settled towards the back - asked for effort with 3f remaining then stayed on one-paced late to finish 8th
Raced up front early on eager terms - lost command approaching 2f - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost room and weakened inside final furlong to finish ninth
Settled with the pack early - up behind the front group by the 2f mark - asked for effort with 2f left - drifted right and lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish well beaten
Fought for control early - sat close to the pace before being urged forward 3f out - dropped away 2f out to finish well beaten
Set the pace early - dropped to second after a furlong - driven into contention entering the straight - regained front spot with a furlong left and stayed on strongly to the line
Held up at the back - into 5th by halfway - urged forward with 2f left - up into 4th inside final furlong - bumped 150 yards out then stayed on to snatch 2nd on the line
settled in the back half - moved up to 4th at halfway - carried left and hampered a neighbour 150 yards out - faded near the line to finish 3rd
Sat behind front pair early - third at halfway - urged into fourth two out then fifth with a furlong left - finished strongly to retake fourth spot near the line
tracked pace early - moved up to front after 1f - driven approaching 2f out then overtaken inside final furlong - faded to finish fifth
slow to break - held up at the back throughout - beaten a long way and well adrift at the finish

Shared control from the outset - settled handy with the front group - made ground through the middle from two out - roused to share the advantage a furlong out - edged in front close home and hung on by a whisker
Contested front spot early - dropped to sit third - moved up to go clear over 2f out - overtaken close to home - unable to find more late and held for second
Held up at the back - began to make progress from over 2f out - up to third with a furlong left - finished strongly on the inner but edged out for second close home
Sluggish start leaves back marker - urged into contention two out and closes on the front three - toils inside final furlong to finish fourth beaten 6½ lengths
Contested the front early - moved ahead after 1f - drifted to the near rail 3f out - lost the advantage 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 5th
Slow into stride - held up towards the back - improved into contention on the left approaching 3f out - lost momentum 2f out - dropped away and finished well held
Near front early - dropped back into the pack soon after - travelled in isolation on the outside from 3f out - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground late to finish 7th
Shared control early - settled second before edging closer approaching 3f out - weakened rapidly with 2f left - well held by the finish
Held mid-pack early - driven into the middle of the track over 2f out but quickly lost touch - dropped away inside the final furlong
Settled in the pack - urged forward to third with a furlong left - hit the front soon after and held on gamely to score
Up with the early pace - nudged along and moved off the far rail 1f out - ran on with purpose inside the final furlong - chased the leader close home but went down by half a length
Set the early gallop - pressed for effort and lost the advantage inside the final two furlongs - stayed on steadily to finish third
Handy in the pack - hit front 2f out - driven and overtaken with a furlong left - lost placings in the closing stages
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - made no real headway - finished 5th
Settled just behind the pace - pressed for gains 2f out - unable to land a serious blow - finished 6th
Settled at the back - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away steadily to finish seventh
Handy early - shared front spot after a furlong - clear in command with 2f left - driven approaching final furlong and stayed on strongly to score
Held up at the back - lost touch early - closed late final furlong - shifted right and took second close home
Race on pace wide - pushed along with a shot approaching final furlong - dropped behind runner-up and held to third late
Up with the front group - nudged forward 2f out and moved right over 1f out - no more to give inside the final 110 yards
Set the pace early - pressed and overtaken with 2f left after being pushed along - lost touch in the closing stages to finish 5th
Fought for control early - sat close to the front group before being pressed for effort 2f out - faded soon after finishing 6th
Settled at back early - shifted middle track and began progress from halfway - challenged front-runner from 1f out - ran on strongly to prevail close home
Handy early - into second spot soon after start - hit front over 2f out - pressed for effort inside final furlong and edged out close home for second
Handy early with the pace - moved up to press front rank over 2f out - put to work and battling near the front from a furlong out - lost momentum close home to finish third
Went straight to front early - pressed for effort when overtaken with 2f left - lost ground close home to finish 4th
held up towards the back - driven approaching final 2f - lost placings inside final furlong and dropped away
Held a forward position early - driven on the far rail with a furlong left before dropping away in a hurry and drifting right close home - well held in 6th
Held up at the back - lost more ground by halfway - unable to hold pace and lost touch inside the final furlong - trailed home well beaten
Settled just behind the pace - pushed along with 2f to run - hit the front inside final furlong and stayed on well to win
Settled in the pack early - driven up into contention inside final furlong - closed on leader in the last 110yds but denied by three quarters of a length
Settled towards the back - urged forward approaching 2f out - closed steadily inside the final furlong - moved into third close home and stayed on to finish third
Settled just off the pace - pushed along with 2f left - closed late to snatch fourth on the line
Settled handy - went ahead over 2f out then pushed along and lost the advantage - lost ground in the closing 110yds to finish fifth
Handy early - shaken up to hit front two furlongs out - overtaken and faded inside final furlong to finish sixth beaten 5¼ lengths
Settled just behind the pace - asked for effort 2f out - unable to make any real dent on those ahead - finished 7th
Settled around mid-pack - pressed for effort 2f out - dropped away quickly - finished well held in 8th
Pulled hard in the chasing pack - pushed along 2f out - faded to finish ninth
Set the pace early - lost the advantage over 2f out and pushed along - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish well beaten
Settled handy early - upsides in second by halfway - edged ahead approaching final 2f - challenged hard inside the last - found extra to prevail

Settled in early stages - 6th at halfway - moved into 3rd turning for home - made headway a furlong out - pressed the front-runner inside the last - had a great shout but rider allowed to coast late - narrowly denied
Sat close up early - held 3rd at halfway - slipped to 5th turning in - rallied into 3rd inside final 2f - stayed on but held for 3rd
Slow into stride - settled towards the back - 11th at halfway - found room and improved over a furlong out - stayed on down the inner to finish 4th
Held up towards the back - still 8th at halfway - moved into 6th turning for home - unable to threaten those ahead and stayed on at one level to finish 5th
Settled handy early - 4th at halfway - asked for effort inside final furlong but couldn't quicken - stayed on same gear to finish sixth
Sat handy early - 5th at halfway - slipped to 7th turning in - unable to threaten the leaders and stayed on one gear late
Driven straight from the break to set the pace - overtaken two furlongs out then dropped back - faded through the closing stages to finish eighth
held up towards the back - still 10th at halfway - unable to close inside final two furlongs and stayed on same tempo late to finish well held
settled midpack early - still 9th at the halfway point - unable to close late and dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 10th
Held up at the back - still 12th at halfway making no headway - unable to quicken in the closing stages to finish well held
slow to break - settled midfield - 7th at halfway - dropped away entering straight and faded final furlong to finish 12th
Slow to break - settled at the back - still 13th at halfway - unable to make headway - dropped away in the closing stages
Went clear early - settled prominently - pushed along with two furlongs left - edged ahead close home to score
Handy early - moved up to dispute front 1f out - edged ahead inside final furlong under strong effort - caught right at the line

Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - hit the front 8f out - came under strong pressure from over a furlong out and gave way inside the final furlong - stayed on same pace for third beaten half a length
Sat behind the front group early - lost ground over 2f out and couldn't close from a furlong out - stayed on to finish fourth beaten 4 1/4 lengths
Settled midfield early - nudged for effort with 3f left - unable to challenge from 2f out and held to the line - finished 5th
Sat close to front pack early - roused with three furlongs left - lost ground final furlong - finished sixth beaten 8 lengths
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - improved position 3f out but unable to threaten leaders 2f out and weakened to finish 7th
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 3f left - unable to close - well held in 8th
Slow to break - settled towards back - pushed along with 3f left and unable to make impression - eventually well beaten in 9th
Handy behind the front group early - urged forward with 4f remaining - lost touch and unable to threaten from over 2f out - well held at the line
Settled in the pack early - dropped away with 4f left - miles off the pace by 2f out - finished 11th
Clumsy break and hesitant to get going - stayed at the back of the field throughout - dropped further off the pace over the closing half-mile - finished last of the field
Settled in second early - moved to front before the second furlong finished - drew clear from over 1f out - kept finding more to score readily
Held a mid-pack position early - moved forward through the pack inside the final furlong and finished strongly - snatched second in the closing strides
Sat close to the pace early - moved into second inside the final furlong - faded in the closing strides to finish third
Went straight to the front - lost the advantage before the second furlong finished then pressed along approaching the final furlong - dropped to fourth and held on for 4th
Held up towards the back - lost touch a furlong out - dropped away close home finishing fifth
Hesitant start - settled at the back - unable to go with the pace from 2f out - dropped right out before finishing well adrift
Handy early - pushed to close gap approaching final furlong then battled gamely through the last stages - got up right at the line
Asked for effort inside final two furlongs and drifted left under pressure - stayed on to the line but caught right at the post
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and finding room to move approaching final furlong - squeezed for space momentarily - moved into third close home - stayed on well to finish third
Sat close to the front group early - pushed along a furlong out - lost momentum in the closing stages - finished 4th beaten 3.5 lengths
Held a mid-pack position early - roused with two furlongs remaining - finished with renewed effort late for fifth
Held a forward spot early - drifted off a true line and pressed for effort 2f out - lost momentum in the closing furlong to finish sixth beaten 3¾ lengths
Settled at back early - moved right two furlongs in - pushed along with two to go - closed steadily over a furlong out but faded in the final 110yds
Sat close to the pace early - asked for effort with 2f remaining - dropped away in final furlong - finished eighth
Settled in the pack early - urged forward with two furlongs left - soon outpaced and well beaten in 9th
Settled towards the back pulling hard early - pushed along with 2f left - unable to land a blow finishing well held in 10th
Fought bit early towards back - pushed along 2f out - unable to close - finished 11th
Settled at the back of the field - pressed for improvement with two furlongs left - failed to land a blow - finished well beaten in 12th
Held a middle position early - pressed for a run 2f out - dropped away soon after - eventually well held in 13th
Slow to break clear of the pack from the off - never travelled and remained at the rear throughout - finished a distant last

Went straight to front - handed up second soon after - tracking rival at halfway - edged in command with a furlong and a half remaining - challenged hard inside final furlong but found extra to prevail
Settled handily early - 4th at halfway - moved into 3rd approaching final two furlongs - up into 2nd inside final furlong - pressed winner late but held short by a neck
Settled early on - held third turning halfway - slipped to fourth with a furlong and a half left - unable to threaten in front but rallied to regain third at the line

Settled just behind the pace early - hit the front soon after - overtaken with a furlong and a half left - slipped back to third inside the final furlong - unable to find more late on and edged out near the line for fourth
Held a forward spot wide early - still involved after the opening furlong - 5th at halfway - unable to progress into the last furlong and held on for 5th at the finish
Held up towards the back - improved into midfield around halfway then into 5th inside the final furlong - slipped back to finish 6th unable to quicken
Handy early - 6th at halfway - unable to close on leading pair inside final furlong and stayed on same gear to finish 7th
Slow to break - settled in the pack then 8th at halfway - unable to threaten leading group approaching final furlong - held same pace to finish well held
Held up towards the back - still 10th at halfway - crept into contention inside the final furlong before finishing without extra late - eventually 9th
settled midfield - 9th at halfway then slipped to last spot with no headway approaching final furlong - held on same pace to finish tenth
Held up towards the back - still in 11th at halfway and unable to close on leaders approaching 1 1/2f out - held to the line finishing 11th
Settled towards the back of the pack - slipped to last of the group by halfway - unable to find more with a furlong and a half to run - eventually well beaten in 12th
Slow to begin - settled towards the back and still 13th at halfway - couldn't quicken final furlong to finish well held
Slow to begin - settled towards the back - still last at the halfway point - lost touch approaching the final 2f and finished well held
Held up early - moving through 3f out - angled right approaching 2f out - hit the front inside final furlong - drew away and kept finding more to the line
Sat close up early - hit front two out before giving way approaching final furlong - unable to match winner's finishing kick
Slow into stride and settled at the back - made progress from over 2f out - moved up to third inside the final furlong - stuck on for third without landing a serious blow
Set the pace early - lost the advantage 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish 4th
Sat close to the front early - dropped away with over 3f left - beaten from that point home - finished fifth
Handy early behind front pack - improved to second inside final two furlongs - hit front close home despite drifting right - held on for the win
Handy early - moved to front before halfway - pressed with a furlong left - squeezed for space when overtaken close home then held for second

Held up early enthusiasm before the off - raced up with the pace - eager under restraint - closed on the front-runner with 2f left - slipped to third with a furlong to run then faded near the finish - finished third
Settled at back of field - urged approaching final furlong but unable to match rivals' pace - dropped away quickly - finished fourth well beaten
Set the early pace - lost the advantage approaching halfway - faded from contention over 2f out and slipped to the rear - well held through the closing stages
Sat close to pace early - hit the front 2f out - driven out to assert and stay clear to the line
Sat close to the pace early - pushed into second inside the final furlong - stayed on but unable to overhaul the winner
Sat close to the front group early - dropped away under pressure 2f out before rallying into third with a furlong left - finished holding the same effort to the line
Settled just off the pace - pushed along with two furlongs left - moved through faltering others late but couldn't land a real blow
Settled in midfield early - pushed along with 2f left - unable to make further impact - finished fifth
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - went clear in front before losing that advantage 2f out under pressure - dropped away final furlong to finish sixth

tracked the pace early - hit the front briefly then lost it after 3f - back in command by halfway - edged away with a furlong left - opened daylight in the closing stages - stayed on strongly to the line
Settled with the pack early - 7th at halfway - moved into contention entering the straight - pushed into 4th inside the final furlong - found extra late to grab 2nd - unable to trouble the winner
Sat close up early - nosed in front after 3f - overtaken at halfway - unable to threaten new front-runner from 1f out - slipped to third late while maintaining effort to the line
Sprang off in front early - soon overtaken and sat handy - 3rd at the midpoint - unable to threaten the pace-setter with a furlong left - slipped to 4th and stayed one-dimensional to the line
Held up towards the back - still 9th at halfway - found some late running inside the final furlong - stayed on into 5th at the line
Held up towards back - still 11th at halfway - found some late headway a furlong out - stayed on to finish 6th
Handy early - 6th at halfway - driven approaching final furlong and finished 7th without further gain
Held a forward spot early - 4th at halfway - moved up 1 1/2f out - eased back to 5th inside final furlong and held on for eighth
Handy early - 5th at halfway - dropped back turning into the straight - ridden along with 1 1/2f left - stayed on at one speed but made no further gain late - finished 9th beaten 7.5 lengths
Held up in the pack early - still down the field at halfway - found some late headway inside final furlong but only stayed on at one speed to finish tenth
Held up in the pack - still down in 13th at halfway - late push from 1f out yields only a little late gain to finish 11th
slow to begin - settled towards the back of the pack - 10th at halfway - pushed along with a furlong left - unable to make headway and finished without response
Held up at the back - still down the field at halfway - unable to make headway late and stayed on same speed to finish 13th
Slow into stride - settled at back of the field - still down in 14th at halfway - unable to make headway inside closing stages - held on for 14th
slow to break - settled in the pack - 8th at halfway - dropped away and pushed along into the straight - faded late to finish 15th
Sat handy behind pace until 4f out - squeezed for space with 2f left - hit front a furlong out and drew away - stayed on strongly to the line
Set the pace early - lost front spot approaching final two furlongs - unable to close on winner in closing stages - beaten 2.75L into second
hesitant start - settled midpack - pushed along with 2f left - closed to take third inside the last furlong

Sat behind the front group early - moved into second spot 4f out before hitting the front over 2f out - drifted left and lost the advantage inside the final furlong - unable to quicken thereafter finishing 4th beaten 3.5 lengths
Missed the break - settled towards the back - squeezed for space approaching 2f out - shifted to the left - stayed on in the closing stages but couldn't threaten the leaders
Settled off the pace in the pack - improved from the outside 4f from home - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 6th
Checked early - settled towards the back - crept forward on the outside 3f out - dropped away 2f out and faded to finish
Slow to break - settled midpack early - faded to 8th by halfway - made ground inside final 2f - rallied in final furlong - up into third with 150 yards left - got up close home to score
Held up towards the back early - improved into 5th by halfway - made ground over a furlong out - flew home late but denied by a length and a quarter in 2nd
Sat close up early - driven into command after 3f - stretched clear approaching final furlong - edged out and outpaced in the closing stages - finished third without a fightback
Quick away to set slight advantage - overtaken by 2f - sat 3rd at halfway - pushed into 2nd spot 3f out - unable to threaten pacesetter inside final furlong - eased back to 4th close home
Slow to break - settled towards the back - 10th at halfway - pushed along over a furlong out - shifted right and found room - progress inside final furlong - stayed on but finished 5th
tucked in early - 4th at halfway then dropped back and pushed along over a furlong out - rallied approaching the final furlong - stayed on to finish sixth beaten 4¼ lengths
Settled just off the pace early - slipped towards the back of the field - 7th at halfway - pushed along a furlong and a half out - couldn't quicken and stayed on one gear to the line
Held up towards back - 6th at halfway - move made into contention over a furlong and a half out - faded in closing 150 yards to finish 8th

Sharp away to sit close up - hit front after 2f then relinquished it after 3f - tracking in second at the midpoint - urged into third with 3f remaining - dropped away entering the final furlong-and-a-half - faded through the closing stages
slow to break and driven up early - lost touch with the pack - made some late progress a furlong out - stayed a peripheral figure and finished well held in 10th
Sat close to the pace early - slipped back to 9th and asked for effort by halfway with little response - faded inside the final furlong to finish 11th
